name: identity
description: Asks before a password, a key, a token, a role or a user changes in an identity or admin app, whatever the request said. Reads are never asked about.

smartRules.name: shield:identity:review-password
smartRules.reason: This changes or resets a password. node9 asks before credentials change, whatever the request said (Identity shield).

smartRules.name: shield:identity:review-key
smartRules.reason: This creates or rotates a key, token or secret. node9 asks before credentials change (Identity shield).

smartRules.name: shield:identity:review-access
smartRules.reason: This grants or revokes access. node9 asks before access changes (Identity shield).

smartRules.name: shield:identity:review-membership
smartRules.reason: This changes who belongs where. node9 asks before membership changes (Identity shield).

smartRules.name: shield:identity:review-user
smartRules.reason: This creates, removes or promotes an account. node9 asks before accounts change (Identity shield).

smartRules.name: shield:identity:review-mfa
smartRules.reason: This changes a second factor. node9 asks before credentials change (Identity shield).
